title: LORD, GRANT ME FAVOR WHEREVER I GO
text: Hallelujah. We bless the name of the Lord. This is the day that the Lord has made and we will rejoice and be glad in it. I want you to understand something about morning. Morning is not just a time of day. Morning is a covenant season. Morning carries a divine vocabulary. The Bible says in Psalm 46 verse 5, "God shall help her and that right early." Right early. There is something about the early hours, something about the morning watch, something about the time when the sun is just beginning to break through the darkness that carries a supernatural edge for those who know how to engage it. You did not wake up this morning by accident. Something pulled you into the presence of God before this day fully unfolded. And I want you to know that the same God who kept you through the night has already gone ahead of you into this day and he's waiting to show you what he placed in it for you. Lift your hands wherever you are and say, "Father, I receive this day as a gift. I receive this morning as an invitation. I receive this moment as a divine appointment. Lord, speak to me. Lord, breathe on me. Lord, fill me with everything I need to walk through this day in absolute victory in the name of Jesus." Somebody shout hallelujah. Today, I want to build something in your spirit. The prayer we are carrying this morning is one of the most powerful prayers any believer can pray. Lord, grant me favor wherever I go. And before I take you into the depths of what this prayer releases, I want to establish something very firmly in your heart. Favor is not wishful thinking. Favor is not positive vibes. Favor is a person. The Bible says the Lord your God is a God of favor. He's a God of grace. And when we ask him to grant us favor, we're not asking for a thing. We're asking for a dimension of his presence to walk with us into every room, every meeting, every conversation, every territory we're about to enter. We're saying, "Lord, let the weight of who you are go before me today." Turn with me in your spirit to the book of Exodus chapter 33. Moses is having one of the most raw, transparent conversations with God in the entire Bible. The children of Israel have just committed the sin of the golden calf. The atmosphere is broken. The covenant is strained, and God tells Moses, "I will not go with you into the land. I will send an angel, but my presence will not go with you." And Moses says something that I want you to write in your heart forever. Moses says in verse 15, "If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence." Moses is saying, "I don't want the land without your presence. I don't want the blessing without the blesser. I don't want the destination without the companionship of the God who promised it to me." And then Moses says in verse 16, "For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? Is it not in that thou goest with us? So shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth?" Do you see what Moses is saying? He is saying the thing that separates us from every other nation, the thing that makes us different, the thing that gives us an edge in a world that is competing for the same resources, the same opportunities, the same platforms, it is the presence of God. It is the favor of God. And I want to declare over your life this morning that the thing that will distinguish you in every room you enter is not your degree, though God can use your degree. It is not your network, though God can use your connections. It is not your eloquence, though God can give you words. The thing that will set you apart is the unmistakable, undeniable, visible presence of God upon your life. And that is what we are asking for this morning. Now, I want to show you something in the book of Ruth. This is one of my favorite examples of sudden, sovereign, supernatural favor. Ruth chapter 2. Ruth is a Moabite woman. She has no legal right to the blessings of the covenant of Israel. She is a foreigner, she is a widow, she is poor, she has no inheritance, she has no father-in-law. She has nothing working in her favor by natural evaluation. And yet in one morning, in one encounter, in one divine appointment that looked like a coincidence, her entire life trajectory changed. The Bible says in verse 3, "And she went and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers. And her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging onto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech." Her hap. That word hap means it happened by chance. But I want you to know that with the children of God, there is no such thing as chance. There are only divine arrangements that look like coincidences to the naked eye. Ruth walked into a field and it just so happened to be the field of Boaz. It just so happened that Boaz came from Bethlehem that exact morning. It just so happened that he looked up and noticed her. It just so happened that he asked about her and found out her story. It just so happened that he told his servants to leave handfuls of grain on purpose for her. That is favor. Favor is when God engineers your steps and causes you to arrive at the right place at the right time in front of the right person who has the authority to change your story. And I am prophesying to someone this morning. God is arranging a divine appointment for you. He is directing your steps toward a Boaz encounter. He is causing your path to intersect with someone who has what you need, who has the doors you've been knocking on, who has the platform you've been believing God for. And it will not look like strategy. It will look like coincidence. But you and I will know it was the favor of God. Let me show you one more thing before we pray. Proverbs chapter 16 verse 7, "When a man's ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him." This is extraordinary. God is saying that favor is so powerful that when it is fully operational in your life, it doesn't just open doors among friends. It silences enemies. It converts opposition into cooperation. It turns the people who were meant to block you into the very people who are celebrating your advancement. I have seen this happen. I have watched people who hated a man, people who swore they would never help him, people who campaigned against him suddenly, sovereignly, inexplicably begin to speak well of him. Begin to open doors for him. Begin to release what was never meant to be released in his direction. That is what God does when favor is activated. And the key in that proverb is this, "When a man's ways please the Lord." Pleasing God is the doorway to supernatural favor. Not performing for men, not trying to impress the crowd, not building an image, but genuinely, sincerely, privately working in a way that makes heaven smile. And tonight, this morning, in this moment, I want to encourage you to make that your pursuit. Not just to pray for favor, but to live a life that attracts it. A life of integrity, a life of purity, a life of prayer, a life of the word. A life where the Holy Spirit is honored as a daily companion, not an emergency contact. That life produces favor that is self-sustaining, favor that doesn't expire, favor that follows you into every room you will ever enter. Now, I want to speak to the things that have been blocking favor in some of your lives. Because not all of us are experiencing the level of favor that God has ordained. And I want to be very direct with you this morning because love demands honesty. One of the greatest favor blockers is unforgiveness. The Bible says in Matthew 6, "If you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly father will also forgive you. There is a direct connection between your willingness to release people and your ability to receive what God has for you. Bitterness builds a ceiling over your life. Offense creates a spiritual blockade. And some of you have been praying for favor and the favor seems to not be flowing because there is someone in your heart who you have not released. This morning, the Holy Spirit is asking you to open your hand and let them go. Not because they deserve it, not because what they did was right. But because your destiny is too important to be held hostage by someone else's wrong. Another favor blocker is disobedience. The Bible says in Deuteronomy chapter 28, "If thou shall hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee." The word overtake means the blessings will chase you down. The blessings will catch up to you. But the condition is hearkening to the voice of God. Obedience is the railway track on which the train of favor runs. When you are obedient to the word, to the spirit, to the assignments God has given you, favor flows naturally. But when there is an area of known disobedience, when there is a command of God you have been postponing, a step of faith you have been avoiding, a sacrifice you have been withholding, it creates friction in the flow of favor. And the Holy Spirit is saying to someone this morning, "The thing I told you to do 3 months ago, the step I asked you to take, the person I asked you to call, the seed I asked you to plant, do it today. Do it before this day ends. And when you take that step of obedience, the log jam will break and favor will begin to flow like a river." I want to speak to someone specifically this morning. You have been waiting for a long time. You've been faithful. You've been consistent. You've been praying. And you've watched others who seem to have started after you receive what you've been believing for. And in your heart, there is a question that you've been afraid to voice. Lord, have you forgotten me? I want you to hear the word of the Lord. God has not forgotten you. The Bible says in Isaiah 49:15 and 16, "Can a woman forget her suckling child that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee. Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands." Your name is written on the hands of God. The God who holds the universe is holding your name. He has not lost track of you. He has not moved on to someone else. The delay was not a denial. The silence was not abandonment. And I prophesy to you this morning, the waiting season is ending. The shift is coming. And when it comes, it will be so sudden, so sovereign, so undeniably God that you will not be able to take the credit, and neither will any man. All the glory will go to the Lord. I want you to begin to share this prayer with someone. If you have a brother, a sister, a friend, someone in your family who needs to encounter the favor of God, share this with them. Do not keep this to yourself. The scripture says in Proverbs 11:25 that he that watereth shall also be watered. When you sow this into someone else's life, you are creating a flow of blessing that will return to you multiplied. Share it now. Send it to someone who is in a difficult season, someone who has been rejected, someone who is about to walk into a critical meeting, a critical interview, a critical conversation. Let them know that God is releasing favor over them right now, in this moment. Go ahead and do that and then come back and let us pray because the prayer we're about to enter into is going to shift things in the realm of the spirit. Now, let us go into the prayer. Get ready. This is not a gentle whispering prayer. The Bible says the kingdom of heaven suffered violence, and the violent take it by force. We're about to take something by force this morning. Lift your hands, open your mouth, and pray with me. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before you with boldness, not because of my own righteousness, but because of the righteousness that belongs to me through the blood of Jesus Christ. I come before the throne of grace to obtain mercy and to find grace to help in the time of need. And this is my time of need, and this is my moment of access. And I am coming boldly, unashamedly, with full assurance of faith into your presence this morning. Father, I thank you. I thank you that I am alive. I thank you that breath is in my body. I thank you that the enemy did not take me in the night. I thank you that I woke up this morning with my mind intact, with strength in my body, with the blood of Jesus still speaking on my behalf. Thank you, Lord. Thank you for this day. I receive it as a gift. I receive it as an assignment. I receive it as a platform for your glory in the name of Jesus. Now, Father, I come before you with one burning request on the altar of my heart this morning. Lord, grant me favor. Wherever I go today, wherever my feet shall tread, wherever my voice shall be heard, wherever my name shall be mentioned, wherever my work shall be seen, Lord, let favor announce me. Let favor go before me. Let favor prepare the hearts of men in my direction. Favor with you, Lord, and favor with men. Let me be like Jesus, who increased in wisdom and stature and in favor with God and man. I receive that scripture as a personal prophecy over my life right now in the name of Jesus. I release faith. Somebody shout amen. Father, I speak to every closed door that is standing between me and my destiny. I speak to every gate that has been shut against me. Every wall that has been erected to keep me from where you have ordained me to be. I declare that by the authority of the name of Jesus and by the power of the blood of the covenant, those doors are opening today. The Bible says, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron. Father, do it in my life this morning. Break every gate of brass. Cut every bar of iron. Let every door that favor requires to open open today. In the name of Jesus. Not tomorrow, not next month, today. Because this is my day. This is my season. And I receive it by faith right now. I speak to the spirit of rejection. I come against every assignment of rejection that has been following my name. Every pattern of rejection. Every cycle of doors closing. Every rhythm of being overlooked and passed over and counted out. I break that cycle today. In the name of Jesus. The Bible says that the stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone. And I declare that what men have rejected God is about to feature. What the enemy has suppressed, God is about to amplify. What has been hidden and ignored and underestimated, God is about to showcase before kings and rulers and decision makers. I break the spirit of rejection off my life, off my career, off my ministry, off my family, off every dimension of my existence in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, let favor speak on my behalf in rooms I have not entered. Let my name find grace in the mouths of people who have never met me. Let the testimony of who you are in my life travel ahead of me into territories I have not yet reached. The Bible says that the Lord gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. You did it for Israel. You can do it for me. Make my enemies my helpers. Make my opponents my supporters. Make the people who swore against me the very people who are confessing for me. Turn every Pharaoh into a promoter. Turn every Goliath into a footstool. Turn every pit into a platform. Father, what the enemy meant for evil, I receive the declaration that you are turning it for good right now in the name of Jesus. I pray for supernatural doors this morning. Doors that I do not have the qualification to open by natural means. Doors that my contacts cannot unlock. Doors that my education cannot reach. Supernatural doors. Divine connections. Kingdom-ordained relationships. Bring them into my path, Lord. Send the right people. Send the Boaz into my field. Send the Jonathan into my David experience. Send the right helper, the right partner, the right mentor, the right door opener. Send the person who has been looking for someone with exactly my gift, exactly my assignment, exactly my passion. Bring us together, Lord. Let divine appointments happen for me today in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Father, I pray for favor in financial matters. Favor in the marketplace. Favor in business. Favor in negotiations. Let every negotiation I enter today tip in my favor supernaturally. Let every contract that has my name on it carry the blessing of heaven. Let every seed I have sown begin to produce a harvest of favor. The Bible says that Abraham was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold. And the reason was not his strategy. It was the blessing of the Lord. Father, let that blessing be activated in my finances. Let favor produce increase. Let favor produce abundance. Let favor cause men to bring wealth into my hands without me manipulating or scheming or compromising. Righteous, kingdom-ordained covenant wealth. I receive it this morning in the name of Jesus. Let me pray for someone specifically right now. If you have an interview today, if you have a meeting today, if you have a presentation or a speech or a conversation that carries significant weight, I am praying for you right now. Father, for everyone connected to this moment who has something of critical importance before them today, let your favor walk into that room before they arrive. Let the hearts of every decision maker, every panel member, every gatekeeper be supernaturally prepared to receive them. Let the words they speak be chosen by the Holy Spirit. Let their presence carry an anointing that cannot be ignored. Let them walk out of that meeting with a yes that is above their expectation. Let them receive more than they dared to ask for, more than they dared to believe because that is who you are. You are able to do exceedingly abundantly above all we ask or think. Father, let this be their reality today in the name of Jesus. Somebody shout hallelujah. Now, I want to speak to the atmosphere over your life this morning. I declare that this is a new season of favor for you. The old cycles are broken. The old patterns are dismantled. The old narrative of lack and rejection and limitation is canceled this morning by the blood of Jesus. A new narrative is being written and the first word of this new narrative is favor. Favor with God. Favor with men. Favor in your health, favor in your family, favor in your finances, favor in your ministry, favor in your career, favor in your education, favor in your relationships. Favor in every territory and every dimension of your existence. The Bible says in Numbers chapter 6, "The Lord bless thee and keep thee. The Lord make his face shine upon thee and be gracious unto thee. The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee and give thee peace." I release that ironic blessing over your life this morning. The face of God is shining on you. Not because you are perfect, not because you have it all together, but because of the blood of Jesus that has made you acceptable, that has made you righteous, that has given you access to the very throne of grace. The face of God is shining on you this morning, and everywhere that light falls, darkness flees, opposition bows, and favor becomes your portion. I want you to say this out loud. Say it with faith. Say it with conviction. Say it and mean every single word. Say, "Lord, I receive your favor. I am a candidate for supernatural favor. I am marked by heaven for distinction. Every door that is mine is opening. Every connection that is mine is coming. Every resource that is ordained for my destiny is finding its way to me. I am favored of God. I am the head and not the tail. I am above and not beneath. The blessing of the Lord is upon my life and it is making me rich and adding no sorrow to it. I walk in favor. I live in favor. I breathe in favor. And this day, this morning, this moment is the beginning of the most favored season of my life in the name of Jesus. Father, seal this prayer with your blood. Seal it with fire. Let every word that has been spoken this morning be a seed that produces a harvest of favor for everyone who has engaged with this moment in faith. And Lord, we give you the glory in advance. We thank you for what you are doing. We thank you for what we cannot yet see. We thank you for the doors that are already open in the spirit. We thank you for the connections that are already aligned in heaven. We thank you for the breakthroughs that are already signed and sealed by your hand. We receive them this morning. We receive them with joy. We receive them with praise. And we declare that our lives will never be the same again in the mighty name of Jesus, in the name that is above every name, in the name before which every knee must bow and every tongue must confess. Jesus. Jesus. Jesus. Somebody begin to bless the Lord right now. Begin to lift your voice in praise. Begin to thank him not for what you are waiting for, but for who he is. Thank him because he is faithful. Thank him because he's a covenant keeping God. Thank him because he does not lie. Thank him because the word he has spoken over your life cannot return to him void. It must accomplish what he sent it to accomplish. It must prosper in the thing where unto he sent it. Your favor is not in question. It is a settled matter in the council of heaven. The only question is whether you will receive it by faith this morning, and I believe you are. I believe as you've engaged with this word, faith has been building. The soil of your heart has been prepared. The seed has been planted, and the harvest is coming. The harvest is coming. Walk into this day with your head lifted. Walking like someone who has been commissioned by heaven. Walking like someone who carries a divine recommendation. Walking like someone whose father owns the cattle on a thousand hills and holds the hearts of kings in his hand. Walking like a favored child of the most high God, because that is exactly what you are. You are not an ordinary person. You are a covenant person. You carry the blood. You carry the name. You carry the spirit. And wherever you go today, favor is going with you. Mercy is following you. Goodness is pursuing you. And the blessing of the Lord is your inheritance today, tomorrow, and every day of your life until you see him face to face. Father, I want to take this moment to go deeper still. I am not done. The spirit of God is still moving, and I will not quench him. There is somebody connected to this moment right now whose breakthrough is sitting at the edge of manifestation, and all it needs is one more push in the realm of the spirit. One more declaration. One more act of violent faith. And I am not going to stop until that thing breaks open. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak to every satanic embargo that has been placed on the favor of your children. Every witchcraft prayer that has been prayed to close doors, every ancestral pattern that has been recycling limitation from generation to generation, every demonic gatekeeper that has been stationed at the entrance of destiny to turn back the blessings of God, I serve you notice this morning. Your assignment is terminated. Your lease has expired. The blood of Jesus has been applied to every door, every gate, every threshold. And what God has opened, no devil in hell has the authority to shut. I declare it. I decree it. I stand on it. In the name of Jesus. Father, I pray for speed now. Not just open doors, but accelerated entry. Lord, make up for lost time. Every year the locust has eaten, every season the enemy has stolen, every opportunity that was swallowed by delay and discouragement and destruction, Father, restore it. The Bible says you will restore the years. Not some of the years. The years. Restoration so complete, so comprehensive, so divinely engineered, that what took others 10 years to build, you will compress into a single season for your children. Supernatural speed. Supernatural acceleration. Let it be their portion right now, in the name of Jesus. I speak to divine helpers now. Men and women who are carrying resources, carrying influence, carrying access, carrying keys to doors that belong to the people of God. Father, connect them. By the compass of the Holy Spirit, draw them together. Let the right hands find each other. Let the right voices find each other. Let kingdom relationships be formed today that will produce generational impact. Let no divine helper be delayed. Let no God-ordained connection be missed. Let every meeting that heaven has scheduled happen on time and in full in the name of Jesus. And to everyone who has prayed this prayer this morning, I declare over you that you are leaving this moment different from how you entered it. Something has shifted in the realm of the spirit. The legal ground has been taken, the declaration has been made, heaven has recorded it and earth must respond to it. Favor is your identity now. Favor is your announcement. Favor is your atmosphere. And as you step into the rest of this day, step in knowing that you are not alone, you are not uncovered, and you are absolutely, irrevocably, supernaturally favored of the Lord. In the name of Jesus. Tell someone today, tell a friend, send this to someone who needs to hear it, share it in a group, pass it to a stranger if you have to. Someone somewhere is waiting for this word. Someone is in a pit, and this is the rope that is going to pull them out. Someone is in a dry place, and this is the water that God has ordained for them this morning. Be a carrier of this blessing. Be a distributor of this grace, because what you give away comes back to you pressed down, shaken together, and running over. And as you go, know that the same God who has released this word over your life is watching over it to perform it. He is not sleeping. He is not distracted. He is actively working on your behalf right now, in the corridors of heaven and in the affairs of men, to bring every word he has ever spoken over your life to pass. This is your day. This is your morning. This is your moment. Go, favored of the Lord, and let the whole world see what God can do with a life that is fully surrendered to him. In Jesus name. Amen.
